purpose: Binding safety, maturity and verification rules for agent automation loops.

kill_switch.behavior: Stop automated writes immediately; report current state only.

circuit_breaker.on_trip: Stop, preserve evidence, update canonical session, escalate to the owner.

never_overwrite: any file the owner approved or edited by hand
require_human_approval: uploading footage or screen recordings to any cloud service (never to generation services)

forbidden_claims: Do not call a feature production-ready before a real application test.
Do not claim a speed, effect or transition was applied without verification.
Do not claim a percentage of automation without measured project evidence.

maturity.L1: Report or recommend only; no project mutation.
maturity.L2: Build a new disposable/review artifact after human request; never overwrite.
maturity.L3: Unattended operation allowed only after repeated verified L2 runs and explicit approval from the owner.
